gloss: to break into a run; to run out; to dash off

forms.negative: {駆|か}け{出|だ}しませんでした

definitions.gloss: to break into a run; to start running; to dash off
definitions.explanation: To suddenly begin running, often triggered by urgency, excitement, or alarm.

definitions.gloss: to run out (of a place); to rush out
definitions.explanation: To run out from inside a building or enclosed space.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
{駆|か}け{出|だ}す is a compound verb: ⟦{駆|か}ける→駆ける：14714_kakeru⟧ (to run) + ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to start / to go out). The ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ component contributes either the meaning of "beginning" (sense 1) or "exiting" (sense 2).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駆|か}け{出|だ}す (to rush outside)
- ⟦{急|いそ}いで→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧{駆|か}け{出|だ}す (to hurry out running)
- ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飛|と}び{出|だ}す→飛び出す：02374_tobidasu⟧ is similar but emphasizes leaving home abruptly

Godan verb (す row): {駆|か}け{出|だ}さない / {駆|か}け{出|だ}します / {駆|か}け{出|だ}して
